press_references.value: SOHAR Port and Freezone launches Ruwaj program

partnership_announcements.description: SOHAR Port and Freezone has partnered with the Youth Center to launch the Ruwaj entrepreneurship development program in North Al Batinah, supporting 100 young Omanis in building market-ready businesses.

press_references.value: Oman–Azerbaijan ties expanding across trade and logistics

partnership_announcements.description: Port of Baku and Alat Free Economic Zone in Azerbaijan are working with SOHAR Port and Freezone in Oman to enhance connectivity between their logistics hubs, aiming to facilitate trade and joint economic initiatives between the two countries.

press_references.value: Sohar Port, Freezone and the Youth Center collaborate on youth skills with Sustainability and Renewable Energy Program

partnership_announcements.description: SOHAR Port and Freezone and the Youth Center have formed a new collaboration to run a month-long Sustainability and Renewable Energy Program that trains over 50 young Omanis in clean energy and carbon management skills aligned with Oman Vision 2040.

press_references.value: Oman ports emerge as global trade pivot

partnership_announcements.description: Dubai Customs has formalised a Green Corridor logistics arrangement with Omani ports, enabling cargo cleared in Oman to move efficiently into the UAE via specified border crossings, reinforcing structured cross-border logistics cooperation.

press_references.value: Sohar Port and Freezone signs land lease agreement with Oman Zinc LLC

partnership_announcements.description: SOHAR Port and Freezone and Oman Zinc entered a strategic partnership via a land lease and investment agreement to develop a zinc ash recycling industrial park in SOHAR Freezone.

press_references.value: Oman’s first synthetic fuels project weighed at Sohar Freezone

partnership_announcements.description: Sohar Port and Freezone signed a Letter of Intent with Swiss research institute Empa to explore a prefeasibility study for establishing Oman’s first synthetic renewable fuels (RFNBO) facility at Sohar Freezone.

press_references.value: Sohar Port and Freezone signs land lease agreement with Pharma Investment Group (FZC) LLC

partnership_announcements.description: Sohar Port and Freezone signed a land lease with Pharma Investment Group (FZC) LLC to establish a 40,000 m² pharmaceutical and medical supplies manufacturing facility in SOHAR Freezone, a USD 20 million project slated to start construction in 2027.

press_references.value: Sohar Port partners with MoonRock and Powercon to introduce sustainable shore power infrastructure

partnership_announcements.description: Sohar Port and Freezone signed an agreement with MoonRock (lead investor) and Denmark’s PowerCon (technical partner) to develop shore power infrastructure at SOHAR’s container terminal.

press_references.value: Initiative to equip students with future-ready skills

partnership_announcements.description: SOHAR Port and Freezone and Kidsity announced a partnership to deliver the third edition of the Maseer summer initiative, providing Omani youth with future-ready skills through immersive learning experiences and workshops.

press_references.value: HM's Netherlands visit boosts Oman-Dutch ties, green energy

partnership_announcements.description: His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik's visit to the Netherlands aims to strengthen Oman-Dutch relations, focusing on trade, investment, and renewable energy. The visit emphasizes cooperation in green hydrogen production, water management, and sustainable logistics, building on historical ties and shared goals for sustainable development.

identifier.value: SOHAR Port Operations and Marine Services

product.name: SOHAR Port Operations and Marine Services
product.description: Port services supporting vessel calls, marine operations, berth access, port procedures, shipping agents, and licensed or registered marine service providers.

product.name: Cargo Handling
product.description: Cargo handling services for dry bulk, liquid bulk, containers, breakbulk, reefer cargo, and specialized shipments, including loading, unloading, storage, and inland transportation.

identifier.value: SOHAR Freezone Investment and Business Setup

product.name: SOHAR Freezone Investment and Business Setup
product.description: Business establishment and investment facilities for companies seeking industrial, logistics, manufacturing, trading, and service operations in Oman.

product.name: SOHAR Freezone Incentives
product.description: A package of investment incentives including 100% foreign ownership, corporate tax exemptions, duty-free import and re-export, and access to selected free trade agreements.

product.name: One-Stop-Shop Licensing and Approvals
product.description: A single-window service for business licensing, permits, government clearances, and related approvals required to establish and operate in SOHAR Freezone.

product.name: Warehousing and Logistics Solutions
product.description: Storage and logistics facilities supporting cargo consolidation, warehousing, distribution, and supply-chain operations within the SOHAR Port and Freezone ecosystem.
